podcast.body: The character "Sally" in Oasis' "Don't Look Back In Anger" might be an intentional or unintentional nod to The Stone Roses' song "Sally Cinnamon." "No one in particular, although it might be a nod to the Stone Rose's song, Sally Cinnamon."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song's 12-inch single was controversially re-released by their former indie label, FM Revolver, in late 1989, complete with a "rather tacky video," all without the band's permission, which ultimately led to the band's grudge attack on the label's offices. "So in late 1989, they re-released the 12-inch for a song called Sally Cinnamon and produced a rather tacky video for it without the permission of the group."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
